title: 第2183章 青龙擒魔图之威第2182章 直面半步大乘
content_zh:
林浩摇了摇头，让李三缺他们暂时不用出手，浑身战意更浓。
刚刚催动超绝品掌中世界神通，与老者交了一次手，受了不轻的伤，可林浩却感受到了那一缕法则的气息，让他有所启发。
“法则是天地诞生之初存在的本源规则，是世界运行的根基，万事万物，包括元力、神通、山川、星辰都要受它约束，此人操控的一缕法则，相当于是调动了一些天地之力，才这么厉害……我若是能借助天地之力，是不是就算领悟了法则。”
林浩看着呼呼落下的恐怖巨大手掌，想到自己在秘境界海之中，施展掌中世界神通，吸收天地间无主天外世界力量，形成的恐怖威力，对半步大乘境的法则，有了很多猜想。
不过，这个时候可不适合悟道。
林浩深吸了口气，准备施展更强的杀招，这一招动用之后，如果不能奈何半步大乘境强者，便动用青龙擒魔手这种古物。
“八荒之势，归一，天外之拳。”
林浩直接展开三种体质巨人之身，神阳霸体、青龙战体，一瞬间与天外世界场景中的古天庭修士、大量猿猴，打出漫天拳影，蓄积出更加恐怖的拳势。
林浩浑身气息达到最高点，猛地挥出一拳，散发出与众不同的拳印波动。
此地聚集的大量拳势，疯狂往林浩的拳头上聚集。
刹那间，一个无比恐怖的巨型拳头出现，爆发出恐怖的吞噬之力。
四面八方的山川地势之力，以及林浩施展超绝品掌中世界神通，形成的天外世界场景快速缩小，没入巨型拳头之中。
此地维持阵法的合体境修士，在恐怖的拳威下不得不后退，在狼狈吐血。
天空中呼呼落下，蕴含一缕法则的巨型手掌，和林浩的巨型拳头碰撞在一起，产生的能量，形成了撕裂虚空般的风暴。
“哇！”
这次交手，林浩伤势更加严重，但那名老者却嘴角也是溢出了鲜血，身体一个踉跄。
“拥有半步大乘境修为的一星高级长老，他竟然被一个合体境修士打伤了！”
被迫退走的一群合体境强者，内心震动不已，只感觉林浩太过凶狂了，比他们以往抓捕的任何一位修士，都要可怕。
“半步大乘境强者能动用一缕法则，我和这种强者还是有一些差距，虽能够伤到他，但继续打下去我必败无疑。”
林浩没有气馁，他只是合体境初期，觉得能够凭借自身力量，伤到掌控一缕法则的半步大乘境强者，已经非常不错了。

“蝼蚁，你竟然敢伤到本长老。”
大罗宗半步大乘境强者脸色无比阴沉起来。
天苍星域灵界，大多数区域的天地环境，都不适合大乘境强者了，一旦大乘境强者离开特殊之地，想要动用法则战斗，就会遭到天苍星域排斥，付出代价。
此人虽然是半步大乘境强者，受到的天苍星域灵界排斥要比真正的大乘境强者，弱上不少。
可在动用法则的情况下，事后也有后遗症，会受到极大的影响，需要前往特殊之地静养很长时间，才能恢复。
这也是天苍星域半步大乘境强者、大乘境强者一直待在特殊之地，很少出手的原因。
“该结束了。”
大罗宗老者目中凶光一闪，准备再动用一次法则，将林浩三人彻底镇压。
他看得出林浩施展刚刚那一拳消耗极大，短时间内肯定施展不出第二拳。
“是该结束了。”
content_en:
Lin Hao shook his head and told Li Sanque and the others not to take action for the time being, and his fighting spirit became even stronger.
He had just activated the supernatural power of the world in the palm of his hand and had a fight with the old man. He was seriously injured, but Lin Hao felt the breath of the law, which inspired him.
"The law is the original rule that existed when the world was born. It is the foundation for the operation of the world. Everything, including Yuanli, supernatural powers, mountains, rivers, and stars, are bound by it. The ray of law controlled by this person is equivalent to mobilizing some of the power of heaven and earth, which is why it is so powerful... If I can use the power of heaven and earth, then I have understood the law."
Lin Hao looked at the terrifying huge palm that whizzed down, thinking that he was in the secret realm sea, using the magical power of the world in his palm, absorbing the power of the unruly outer world between heaven and earth, and forming a terrifying power. He had many guesses about the laws of the half-step Mahayana realm.
However, this time is not suitable for enlightenment.
Lin Hao took a deep breath and prepared to use a stronger killing move. After using this move, if he could not defeat a half-step Mahayana strongman, he would use an ancient artifact like the Qinglong Demon Capturing Hand.
"The power of the Eight Desolations, unified, the fist from outside the world."
Lin Hao directly unfolded the three physical giant bodies, the Shenyang Tyrant Body and the Azure Dragon Fighting Body. In an instant, he and the ancient heavenly monks and a large number of apes in the outer world scene filled the sky with fist shadows, accumulating even more terrifying punches.
Lin Hao's aura reached its highest point, and he punched out violently, emitting a unique punch mark wave.
A large number of fists gathered here, crazily gathered on Lin Hao's fist.
In an instant, an extremely terrifying giant fist appeared, erupting with terrifying devouring power.
The power of the mountains and terrain in all directions, as well as Lin Hao's use of the extraordinary magical power of the world in his palm, caused the scene of the outer world to shrink rapidly and be submerged into the giant fist.
The Fusion Realm monks who maintained the formation here had to retreat under the terrifying power of the fist, vomiting blood in embarrassment.
Falling from the sky, a giant palm containing a ray of law collided with Lin Hao's giant fist, and the energy generated formed a storm that ripped through the void.
"Wow!"
In this fight, Lin Hao's injuries were more serious, but the old man's mouth also overflowed with blood, and his body staggered.
"A one-star senior elder with half-step Mahayana realm cultivation was injured by a Fusion realm monk!"
The group of strong men in the Fusion Realm who were forced to retreat were shocked in their hearts. They felt that Lin Hao was too ferocious and more terrifying than any of the monks they had captured before.
"A half-step Mahayana strongman can use a ray of law. There is still some gap between me and such a strong man. Although I can hurt him, if I continue to fight, I will definitely lose."
Lin Hao was not discouraged. He was only in the early stage of the Fusion Realm and felt that it was already very good to be able to use his own strength to hurt a half-step Mahayana Realm expert who controlled a ray of law.
"Ant, how dare you hurt this elder."
The face of the half-step Mahayana realm expert from Da Luo Sect became extremely gloomy.
In the spiritual world of Tiancang Star Territory, the heaven and earth environment in most areas is not suitable for Mahayana Realm powerhouses. Once Mahayana Realm powerhouses leave this special place and want to use the laws to fight, they will be ostracized by Tiancang Star Realm and pay the price.
Although this person is a half-step Mahayana realm expert, the rejection from the spiritual world of the Heavenly Cang Star Realm is much weaker than that of a true Mahayana realm expert.
However, when the law is used, there will be sequelae afterwards, which will be greatly affected and require a long period of rest in a special place to recover.
This is also the reason why the half-step Mahayana realm experts and Mahayana realm experts in Tiancang Star Region always stay in special places and rarely take action.
"It's time to finish."
The old man of Daluo Sect flashed a fierce light in his eyes, and was about to use the law again to completely suppress Lin Hao and the others.
He could see that Lin Hao used a lot of energy to execute the punch just now, and he would definitely not be able to execute the second punch in a short time.
"It's time to end."
